name: Okihi Kanae
source:
A teacher with a gentle demeanor, well-liked by the students.
He believes in treating his students as individuals before viewing them simply as pupils, and always tries to act in their best interest.
However, after angering Inori, he is transformed into the appearance of a small girl.
Not only does he begin attending the school as a female student, but he also ends up having to help Inori with the task of collecting semen on his behalf…
